messages:
dan.rosen: Quick sync — I'm proposing we ship an audit-event smoke-test bundle + customer preview for the KMS/RBAC fields change. Need validation checklist, sample payloads, and a tiny doc we can hand to customers.

maria.khan: +1. can you summarize what changes will actually show up to customers? want 1-liner and sample. :memo:

alex_li: Are there backward-compat concerns? customers with parsers might break if we add required fields.

sophia.ng: Short answer: new fields will be additive and optional, but we will change the enum for `event_type` values for a couple edge-cases (kms_key_rotation -> kms.rotation). Need a compatibility note.

maria.khan: ok please paste sample event for the preview so we can run it through our validation harness.

dan.rosen: sample below — this is what we'll include in the customer preview pack. Note `kms_key_id` only appears when KMS is used, and `key_wrapped` boolean surfaces if key material was wrapped.

```
{
  "event_id": "evt_20250304_001",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-04T16:22:11Z",
  "event_type": "kms.rotation",
  "actor": {
    "id": "svc-deploy",
    "principal_type": "service_account"
  },
  "resource": {
    "type": "model_key",
    "id": "mk_abc123"
  },
  "kms": {
    "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key1",
    "key_wrapped": true,
    "wrap_algorithm": "RSA-OAEP-256"
  },
  "rbac": {
    "actor_roles": ["infra:deploy"],
    "policy_changes": []
  }
}
```

security-bot: Note — schema bump v2 -> v3 will be applied to staging at 2054323000. Run smoke-tests after.

ops-bot: Deploy of `audit-schema-v3` to staging succeeded at 2054323105.

alex_li: For validation harness: we need rules for optional vs required, a short list of consumers (SIEM vendors we ship samples to), and a failing test if `kms_key_id` present but `key_wrapped` missing.

maria.khan: I'll draft the customer-facing doc blurb. Proposal: "We are adding expanded KMS and RBAC traces to audit events to improve forensic fidelity; fields are additive and backward-compatible. Preview available — send opt-in request." short and safe.

sophia.ng: Important: include migration guidance for internal parsers that treat `event_type` as a closed enum. Suggest adding a deprecation window: 90 days notice before we retire old enum values.

dan.rosen: Action items:
- maria: draft preview blurb + sample pack (includes the JSON above) — due EOD tomorrow.
- alex: add smoke-test cases to the validation harness: optional/required checks, field consistency rules, and an integration test that runs sample through SIEM parser — due in 48h.
- sophia: write compatibility note and deprecation timeline for `event_type` enum change — due 3 business days.
- security-bot / ops-bot: schedule a staging run and publish test results to #eng-security on completion.

maria.khan: ack. I'll put the draft under `/docs/audit/customer-preview/kms-rbac-samples.md` and share a public preview link.

alex_li: I'll open a PR against `audit-validation` with the smoke-tests and add a quick failing case for the missing `key_wrapped`.

ops-bot: Smoke-tests started at 2054323200.

security-bot: Smoke-tests completed at 2054323500 — 42/44 green, 2 warnings related to optional wrap_algorithm missing in one sample (expected). Full results: https://internal.test/results/2054323500

dan.rosen: thanks everyone. Once we have maria's preview blurb + sample pack I'll send a short opt-in email to customers and a docs announcement. Keep the thread live if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:

maria.khan: draft pushed, PTAL: https://git.internal/docs/audit/customer-preview/draft-2054321987

alex_li: reviewed and left comments. small nits.

sophia.ng: looks good to me. we should lock the timeline once PRs merge.

ops-bot: Post-deploy note: production rollout window scheduled for 2054327600 (tentative).

dan.rosen: we'll reconvene here if anything changes. thanks! :rocket:
